text:
Peanuts Native 

 
 Nintendo Switch games running natively on Android dual-screen handhelds, with a live companion on the second screen.
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
   
 

 [!NOTE]
 Peanuts Native is in development. The current release is on the releases page. It is not affiliated with Nintendo.

 What it is

Peanuts Native turns a dump of a Switch 1 game you own into an Android app on your phone. It is not an emulator. The
game's own ARM64 code is rewritten to run directly on the phone's CPU, its graphics are replayed on Vulkan, and its
shaders are translated on the device. Everything happens on the phone: you pick the game file, tap Build, and play.

On a dual-screen handheld such as the AYN Thor, the game plays on the top screen and the bottom screen shows a
companion for that game: a map, your party, items or quests, read live from the running game and touchable. Companions
use the same package format as Eden Duo, so every Eden Duo companion works here
too.

 Supported games

 

Peanuts Native 0.1.9 includes 87 games. The Companion column shows whether a game appears in the Eden Duo Companions catalog, and the Contributor column the community members who brought a game to Peanuts Native. Updates are shown as version numbers or numeric update IDs.

install.title: Getting started
install.html:
1. Install the APK and allow All files access when asked.
  2. On the first screen, add your Keys (prod.keys), pick your Game folder, and add your Firmware. Both keys and firmware are needed before the first build. A build folder is optional (Settings, Library, Build folder): pick one, on the phone or the microSD card, to keep every build there, organized by title ID.
  3. Open a game from the library and tap Build. The app imports the game, rewrites its code, translates its shaders and installs its companion. Most games take 5 to 40 minutes on the Thor.
  4. Tap the game to play. The companion starts on the bottom screen.

Hold a game's cover to open its own page: picture and speed settings, mods, the companion, saves and storage. After an app update, rebuilding every game is strongly recommended: hold the cover, open Storage, tap Build again, then Rebuild.
